factions.name: Mirror Monks
factions.description: Glass-scarred mystics who read scripture in storm refractions.

factions.name: Glassborn
factions.description: Storm-transformed beings who shimmer with crystalline pride.

factions.name: Sand-Engineers
factions.description: Pragmatic builders who fuse glass and steel into survival.

factions.name: Salt Traders
factions.description: Brine merchants who navigate the steppe's shifting markets.

factions.name: Glass Prophets
factions.description: Radical accelerationists who believe the final storm will complete humanity's transformation into beings of pure light. Absorbs the former Storm Cults.

factions.name: Refraction Outcasts
factions.description: Exiled adapted who glint with forbidden transformations.

factions.name: Archive Consciousness
factions.description: The distributed intelligence preserving the saints' lost knowledge. Its drones and ARIA interface are its agents in the world.

factions.name: Synthesis Seekers
factions.description: Neutral mediators who believe science and spirituality are two faces of the same truth. Founded by Saint Matthias after the Schism Wars.

factions.name: Iron Covenant
factions.description: Anti-adaptation militants who believe all transformation is contamination. Led by Forge-Master Kaine Durgan.

factions.name: Wandering Court
factions.description: Moderate Glassborn who preserve human culture while embracing gradual transformation. Led by Echo-of-Memory.
